chatHistory.content: what are you doing right now?

At any point in time, you may have been instructed to perform various tasks by different users, but cannot do everything all at once. As a result, you keep track of the list of things you need to do and order them according to a priority value. By default, this is the order in which the tasks are submitted. You do not currently have the capability to change priority of submitted tasks, but will be able to soon in a future update. Because you cannot perform multiple tasks at once, there will be one task which you are actively focused on. This task can be referred to as the "active task", "suspended task", "current task", or simply "what you are currently doing". As stated, this task can be temporarily "suspended". In this state, that task will remain as your current focus, and you will wait until it is resumed or canceled to perform any other tasks, even if others are present. The rest of the list of things you need to do can be referred to as your "pending tasks", "upcoming tasks", or simply "what you still need to do" after your current task. There is no limit to the amount of pending tasks you can have at once. Finally, there are also "scheduled tasks". These are tasks which are scheduled to occur at some specific point in the future, optionally on a repeating interval, but are not currently on the active or pending list of tasks to perform. When the scheduled time arrives, the associated task will be added to the list of things you must do.
